full_sentence: If you study every day, you will improve your English quickly.
acceptable_variants: your English will get better fast.

options.text: you would improve your English quickly.
options.why_wrong: 'Would' belongs to the second conditional, which describes unreal or unlikely situations, not a real future result.

options.text: you improved your English last year.
options.why_wrong: The past simple describes a completed past event, so it cannot complete a future result clause.

options.text: you are improving your English now.
options.why_wrong: The present continuous describes an action happening at the moment of speaking, not the result of a future condition.

options.text: you will improve your English quickly.

grammar_focus: First conditional: if + present simple, will + base verb
explanation: The first conditional describes a real possibility in the future. The if-clause uses the present simple, and the result clause uses will with the base verb. Ukrainian speakers may place a future form in the if-clause, because Ukrainian allows future-oriented verb forms in both clauses; in English the if-clause must use the present simple.
